# Subtitle Toolkit

> Free subtitle and caption utilities that run entirely in the browser. Subtitle files are never uploaded — all processing is client-side JavaScript.

Site: https://toolboxes.top/
Last updated: 2026-09-17

## Tools

- [SRT to VTT Converter](https://toolboxes.top/tools/srt-to-vtt): Convert .srt subtitle files to WebVTT (.vtt) for HTML5 video, right in your browser.
- [VTT to SRT Converter](https://toolboxes.top/tools/vtt-to-srt): Turn WebVTT files back into SubRip (.srt) for editors, players and upload platforms.
- [Remove Timestamps from Subtitles](https://toolboxes.top/tools/remove-timestamps): Strip timestamps and cue numbers to get a clean, readable transcript.
- [Clean Up AI-Generated Subtitles](https://toolboxes.top/tools/clean-subtitles): Remove sound cues, HTML tags, speaker labels and duplicate cues from auto-generated captions.
- [Shift Subtitle Timing](https://toolboxes.top/tools/shift-subtitles): Move every subtitle cue earlier or later to fix out-of-sync captions.
- [Resync Subtitles by Frame Rate or Speed](https://toolboxes.top/tools/resync-subtitles): Fix subtitles that drift progressively out of sync by resampling them to your video's frame rate or playback speed.
- [SBV to SRT Converter](https://toolboxes.top/tools/sbv-to-srt): Convert YouTube .sbv caption files to SubRip (.srt), right in your browser.
- [Merge Subtitle Files](https://toolboxes.top/tools/merge-subtitles): Combine two SRT or VTT files into one track, with the second file appended after the first.
- [Subtitles to CSV Converter](https://toolboxes.top/tools/srt-to-csv): Export SRT or VTT cues to a CSV spreadsheet with start time, end time, duration and text.
- [Split Subtitle Files](https://toolboxes.top/tools/split-subtitles): Cut one SRT or VTT track into two files at any timestamp, right in your browser.
- [Fix Garbled Subtitles (Encoding Repair)](https://toolboxes.top/tools/fix-subtitle-encoding): Repair mojibake — subtitles showing Ã©, â€™ or Ð¿Ñ€Ð¸Ð²ÐµÑ‚ instead of real characters.
- [Subtitle Timing Checker](https://toolboxes.top/tools/subtitle-timing-check): Audit an SRT or VTT file for cues that are too fast, too short, too long or overlapping.

## Key facts

- Supported formats: SubRip (.srt), WebVTT (.vtt), and .sbv-style arrow syntax.
- No account, no usage quota, no watermark, no file size limit.
- Processing is 100% client-side; subtitle content is never transmitted.
- Output format follows the input format unless an explicit conversion is chosen.

- [AI tool directory](https://ai.toolboxes.top/): a directory of AI tools, including transcription and captioning services.
